label: ABC2_oP16_33_a_a_2a-001
title: $\beta$-NaFeO$_{2}$ Structure
comments:
NaFeO$_{3}$ is found in three different forms (El-Shobaky, 1988; Singh 2018). \begin{itemize} \item \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_hR4_166_a_b_c-009}{$\alpha$-NaFeO$_{2}$} is the low temperature structure \item \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_oP16_33_a_a_2a-001}{$\beta$-NaFeO$_{2}$} (this structure) is the intermediate temperature structure, which exists at room temperature, and \item $\gamma$-NaFeO$_{2}$, the high temperature form, is in the \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_tP16_92_a_a_b-001}{$\gamma$-LiAlO$_{2}$ structure}. \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 The temperature range seems to be uncertain, $\beta$-NaFeO$_{2}$ is said to be the room temperature structure (Viret, 2012) but $\alpha$-NaFeO$_{2}$ is observed at 1000$^\circ$C (El-Shobaky, 1988). 
 Although the title from (Viret, 2012) says ``new,'' this structure was first reported in 1950 by (Berataut, 1954) (ICSD 27117, CCDC 1602445). 
 Space group $Pna2_{1}$ \#33 is polar and so allows an arbitary choice of the zero of the $z$-axis.  Here we set z$_{1}$ = 0 for the Fe I atoms. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_oP16_33_a_a_2a-001}{$\beta$-NaFeO$_{2}$} and \href{current_web_home_dir/ABC2_oP16_33_a_a_2a-003}{LiGaO$_{2}$} have the same AFLOW prototype label, ABC2\_oP16\_33\_a\_a\_2a. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
